title: Return the next slice body in one call to cut a model round trip
lead:
The agent loop forces two turns to begin work: `next --json` to get the id, then
`show ID --json` to read the slice. Every turn replays the whole growing context,
so that second turn is the most expensive unit in the flow. `next --start` already
proves the "fuse two steps into one call" pattern; the read half is still split.
Add `--show` so `next` (and `next --start`) returns the item together with the slice
sections, boundary, and dependencies in one payload, removing a full model turn per
slice picked up.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
A driving agent cannot implement from `next` alone — it always follows with `show`.
Because each command is a separate model turn and each turn re-sends the entire
context, collapsing `next`+`show` into one call saves far more than trimming bytes.
This is the single highest-leverage credit optimization in the agent flow.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: `src/slicer/cli.py` (the `next` subcommand's argparse and `cmd_next`), `docs/agents.md` and `src/slicer/ai.py` (document the one-call loop), and `tests/test_next.py`. No `ops.py` change is needed: the slice is already in memory as `state.slices`, the same lookup `show` uses.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add `--show` to the `next` subparser. When set and the item has a slice, merge its `slice` object (the same shape `show ID --json` returns) into the payload via `state.slices.get(id)`, and append the rendered slice in text mode. Composes with `--start` and `-n`; `next` is not a mutating-wrapped command and has no `--render` flag. Omit the key when the item is unpromoted. Leave the default `next` output unchanged.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `next --show --json`'s `slice` equals `show ID --json`'s `slice` (the fused read equals the two-call composition; the `next` payload additionally carries `path` and `effective_score`). `next --start --show` returns the started item with its slice. The empty/blocked envelope and exit 2 stay unchanged when `--show` is set. `docs/agents.md` and `ai instructions` describe the one-call loop.
